prompt: Create a full-body dark fantasy pixel-art character portrait of Anubis, an imposing anthropomorphic jackal-headed Egyptian god-warrior standing against a pure black background. The figure is centered, front-facing in a slight three-quarter stance, tall and extremely muscular, with charcoal-gray stone-like skin, a black jackal muzzle, tall pointed ears, sharp claws, bare digitigrade feet, and glowing golden amber eyes. He wears ornate ancient Egyptian armor and jewelry in tarnished gold, dark teal enamel, and weathered linen. Count and include exactly 12 main visible costume and accessory elements: 1 striped pharaoh-style nemes headdress with gold trim and teal panels, 2 leafy green laurel or vine strands draped over the crown, 3 broad gold-and-teal collar necklace, 4 large gold ankh pendant at the chest, 5 smaller dark ankh marking or pendant on the abdomen, 6 stacked gold bracelets on the weapon-holding wrist, 7 gold-and-teal upper arm band, 8 ornate belt with a large central green gemstone, 9 hanging front loincloth panel with an ankh symbol and geometric Egyptian patterns, 10 tattered beige side skirt strips, 11 matching gold-and-teal forearm bracer, 12 matching gold-and-teal shin guards and knee plates. In his left hand he holds a massive cracked obsidian greatsword resting across his shoulders; the blade is jagged black stone with glowing orange lava fissures and a fiery molten tip. Add a dangling gold ankh charm from the sword hilt. The mood is regal, brutal, mythic, and intimidating. Use crisp high-detail 16-bit / 32-bit game sprite rendering, strong rim lighting, dramatic highlights on the gold, subtle lava glow from the sword, visible pixel texture, clean silhouette, no text, no border, no watermark, black empty background.

promptZh: 创建一个全身暗黑奇幻像素风格的角色肖像，主角为 阿努比斯，一位威严的拟人化胡狼头埃及神祇战士，背景为纯黑色。人物居中，正面朝向，呈轻微的三分之二侧身站姿，身材高大且肌肉极其发达，拥有炭灰色如岩石般的皮肤、黑色胡狼口鼻部、高耸的尖耳朵、锋利的爪子、裸露的趾行足，以及发光的 金琥珀色 双眼。他身穿华丽的古埃及盔甲和珠宝，材质包括失去光泽的黄金、深青色珐琅和风化的亚麻布。请统计并包含 12 个主要的可见服装及配饰元素：1 个带有金边和青色镶板的条纹法老式尼美斯头巾，2 条垂在头冠上的叶状绿色月桂或藤蔓，3 条宽大的金青色项圈，4 个胸前的大型金色安卡挂坠，5 个腹部较小的深色安卡标记或挂坠，6 个持武器手腕上的叠戴金手镯，7 个金青色上臂环，8 条带有大型中央绿色宝石的华丽腰带，9 条带有安卡符号和几何埃及图案的垂挂式前腰布，10 条破损的米色侧裙带，11 个配套的金青色前臂护腕，12 个配套的金青色护胫和膝甲。他左手持一把巨大的裂纹黑曜石巨剑，扛在肩上；剑身是锯齿状的黑色岩石，带有发光的橙色熔岩裂缝和炽热的熔岩尖端。在剑柄上增加一个悬挂的金色安卡吊坠。整体氛围庄严、残暴、神话感且令人畏惧。采用清晰的高细节 16 位 / 32 位游戏精灵渲染，强烈的轮廓光，黄金上戏剧性的高光，剑身细微的熔岩光芒，可见的像素纹理，清晰的剪影，无文字，无边框，无水印，黑色空白背景。
